explication: Locally Uncensored is a desktop local-AI studio with chat, media creation, coding/agent tools, model management, and voice; it also has an Android client. The main user journey is choosing a model and using it in chat or Create, with local runtimes or LU Cloud providing inference and generated results. The graph includes documented capabilities and sampled runtime layers. Some feature wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so those relationships are omitted rather than inferred from directory names.
